summary: Usable and convincing. Both views read immediately as a one-handed military cleaver: the broad faceted blade, reinforced spine, swept guard, ribbed grip, and compact pommel create a distinctive silhouette with credible Halo CE-era low-poly economy. Metal, bronze guard, and grip components separate clearly, though the grip is lighter than the README’s “dark rubber” description. The 1.2975 m overall length closely matches the 1.3 m catalogue reach, with plausible one-handed proportions. The 1,000-triangle/5-material construction is efficient, and the documented grip/blade markers plus separated guard, grip, pommel, and blade parts are useful for integration.
